steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In June 2026, Equity Mates described IWG’s coworking offering as attractive for companies avoiding five-year leases by choosing flexible shared space. Research cited suggested coworking could reach 10% to 30% of global office space by 2030, with landlords even dedicating multiple floors to it.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In June 2026, Equity Mates argued AI was a tailwind for IWG because expanding firms preferred flexible offices and landlords increasingly included coworking floors. They pointed to forecasts that coworking could grow from about 2% in the US to 10% to 30% globally by 2030.
